  have hrec := h_parent1 (x + 3) (9 - x) 1 ⟨hA, hB, hC⟩
  have hsum : (x + 3) + (9 - x) + 1 = (13 : ℝ) := by ring
  have hab : (x + 3) + (9 - x) = (12 : ℝ) := by ring
  have hbc : (9 - x) + 1 = 10 - x := by ring
  have hca : (1 : ℝ) + (x + 3) = x + 4 := by ring
  rw [hsum, hab, hbc, hca] at hrec
  exact hrec
